name: manor

candidates.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is a precise footprint geometry template, image2 is the building/material edit target. Rebuild this Ming north Chinese wealthy merchant courtyard compound with exact geometry from image1. Keep image2 hall-and-two-side-wings arrangement, grey brick hard-gabled roofs, sober grey tiles, brown wooden lattice doors, entrance gate on front wall, and all realistic textures. Required ONLY change: lower the camera ground-edge pitch to EXACT 2:1 dimetric axes, 26.565 degrees to horizontal, slopes +0.500 and -0.500. Both diagonal families are parallel; no perspective convergence. KEEP footprint nearly-square 16 wide by13 deep: visible left-to-front stone base edge is 1.23077 times visible front-to-right stone base edge. Both dimensions nearly equal, do NOT elongate front facade. Build all walls and roofs aligned with exact input geometry template. Full thin stone rectangular pad visible at all three visible corners, foundation thickness only 2px, entrance steps stay inside footprint. Fine brickwork and tiles, hard gable walls flush with roofs, light upper-left, soft shadow only inside pad. Photoreal-painted strategy game 45degree isometric building sprite. Background true transparent alpha0, no background scenery or text, no people, no watermark. Final must be a faithful architectural rendition of image2 placed onto geometrically correct image1 footprint. Preserve transparent margins.

Sketch-to-render: render a wealthy Ming northern China merchant courtyard compound DIRECTLY ON THIS EXACT FOOTPRINT, copy the reference polygon shape unchanged. Isometric GAME MAP sprite at unusual FLATTER-THAN-NORMAL projection: ground axes angle 26.565 degrees, NOT 30 degrees. Each ground edge progresses 2 horizontal pixels per 1 vertical pixel. Outer courtyard footprint ratio16:13. Existing polygon must stay exactly fixed: left(192,640), near(827.6,957.8),right(1344,699.6),back(708.4,381.8). Grey paving inside polygon, no ground or shadows beyond. All enclosure walls aligned to polygon, build upwards vertically. Symmetric grey-brick northern Chinese courtyard with rear main hall and two side wings, flush hard gables, grey tubular roof tiles, brown wooden lattice doors, central gate in front wall, small plants inside court. Fine realistic brick/tile/wood detail, restrained antique painted game asset, light upper left, no people, no signage. Geometric acceptance is strict: the front wall must have slope +0.500 and right wall -0.500, and front wall 1.23077 times right wall. Make roof profiles compact so all roof and pad corners remain visible within 10% transparent padding. Erase guide marks but retain exact base silhouette. True alpha0 transparent background. Do not add camera perspective, thick plinth, text, characters or watermark.

selection_reason: 两候选内优先保留形制与材料，并兼顾斜率和比例；未达标如实登记
final_view_image_review: 第2轮已逐张view_image规范化成品：轮廓及底面完整，透明留边，左上光向、纹理密度可读；几何仍有已登记残差，尚不通过严格审核。
